text:
alex: Quick sync — we need a crisp checklist for gating v2 route rollouts. Customers keep asking about compatibility guarantees and opt-in paths.
miriam: Agree. I'd start with must-have launch gates: API parity for core endpoints, SDK bump documented, migration guide, and smoke evals.
devon: +1. Also include fallback policy: if v2 returns 5xx or quality regression > X on eval set -> auto-fallback to v1 for that tenant.
sara: How do we measure 'quality regression'? We have eval harness but need a threshold. Suggest PSNR-like metric for embeddings and pass-rate on core prompts for chat.
tim: For chat/completions, let's use a guarded prompt set (~200 utterances) that maps to production intents. Regression = >5% drop in acceptance score vs baseline.
alex: That sounds reasonable. Add latency and cost constraints: median latency < 120ms for hosted tier, P95 < 350ms, and 15% unit-cost delta cap vs v1 for initial customers.
miriam: We should specify customer mapping: Tier A (enterprise customers with SLAs) go through dedicated canary and a manual opt-in. Tier B (self-serve) get gradual percentage routing via feature flag.
devon: For routing, we need header-based opt-in + per-tenant control in Console. Implementation note: add X-Redwood-Route: v2 header and fallback TTL in headers.
sara: Docs/SDK: include code examples for setting header, sample responses showing structured output differences, and 'compatibility shim' snippet for function/tool calling differences.
alex: Ops checklist: rollout playbook, runbooks for quick rollback, monitoring dashboards (tokens, latency, error rate, quality score), and alerting thresholds. Who owns each?
tim: I can own monitoring + alerts. Miriam can own docs and SDK examples. Devon + Ops should own the routing implementation and rollback automation.
miriam: Also we need a migration helper for customers: a small tool that runs their representative traffic through v2 in dry-run mode and reports regressions. Can we scope a simple CLI first?
devon: CLI + Console dry-run view. We'll need an API endpoint for eval jobs and a way to tag samples. Schedule: CLI MVP in 3 sprints?
sara: For rollout criteria checklist, include: 1) Eval pass rate, 2) No unknown breaking changes in tool calls, 3) Backwards-compatible headers exist, 4) Docs updated, 5) Support oncall scheduled.
alex: Timeline proposal: week 0-2 spec & customer mapping, 3-6 implement routing & header shim, 7-9 build CLI dry-run + docs, 10-12 canary with 5 enterprise customers, week 13 decide general availability. Thoughts?
miriam: Need parallel work item: deprecation timeline for v1. Suggest announce window = 6 months after GA, plus extended support for enterprise contracts.
devon: Ensure we can do roll-forward (fix forward) vs roll-back. Some changes (quantization, kernel swaps) might need quick roll-forward with patch versions.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deployment to staging cluster at 1972007800.
tim: Small note on instrumentation: tag all v2 requests with route_id and canary_id, expose percent-routed in Console.
sara: Customer comms: draft post for customer newsletter explaining opt-in, benefits, and migration support. Include known incompatibilities and timeline.
alex: OK action items: Miriam -> migration guide & comms draft; Devon -> routing headers + fallback; Tim -> monitoring dashboards; Sara -> eval harness threshold and sample set; I'll shadow customer-mapping and coordinate enterprise invites. We'll reconvene Friday. :thumbsup:
miriam: On it. I'll post PR with docs outline by EOD tomorrow.
devon: I'll spike on header + fallback TTL today and share patch.
sara: I'll assemble the prompt set and baseline metrics by Thursday.
tim: Will stub dashboards and alerts this week.
alex: Thanks team — short sync Friday 10am.
